source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Stratify clients into risk categories, guiding proactive preparedness measures such as blood type/crossmatch and available resources","B":"Taking the place of the ongoing clinical assessment a nurse would otherwise perform continuously throughout labor and delivery","C":"Applying mainly to clients undergoing a cesarean delivery, rather than to laboring clients being admitted more generally","D":"Diagnosing hemorrhage only after it has already clearly begun, rather than helping the team anticipate it ahead of time"}}
source_row.rationale: Standardized postpartum hemorrhage risk assessment tools stratify clients into risk categories upon admission, guiding proactive preparedness measures such as blood type/crossmatch and appropriate resource availability.
source_row.source_name: AWHONN / ACOG — Postpartum Hemorrhage Risk Assessment
source_row.stem: A nurse uses a standardized postpartum hemorrhage risk assessment tool upon a client's admission to labor and delivery. This tool helps:
